data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat rental weather december trip? December in Marbella offers a surprising blend of mild Mediterranean winter and festive seaside atmosphere. With average highs of 16°C, eight hours of daily sunshine, and calm seas, it's an excellent time for a half-day charter from Puerto Banús. The crowds have thinned, the marina glitters with holiday lights, and the water remains navigable—though a wetsuit is recommended if you plan to swim. This guide covers what to expect from December weather, which boats from our fleet suit the season, and how to make the most of your festive charter.

December Weather Averages for Marbella

December in Marbella is mild and generally pleasant. Daytime temperatures range from 13°C to 18°C (55–64°F), with an average of 16°C. Sea temperatures hover around 16°C, making swimming possible but brisk. Rainfall is limited to about five days per month, and most days see clear or partly cloudy skies. Wind speeds average 10–15 km/h, rarely exceeding 20 km/h, so sea conditions are typically calm—ideal for cruising along the Costa del Sol. Sunset occurs around 18:00, so plan your charter to maximise daylight hours.

Best Boats for December Charters

For a December charter, we recommend enclosed or flybridge boats that offer shelter from the breeze. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are excellent choices—both are Tier A boats priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, snacks, and IVA. For larger groups, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) provide spacious interiors. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and a welcome pack of water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks.

What to Expect on a December Boat Trip

December cruising offers a different perspective on Marbella's coastline. The sea is calm, the light is soft, and the mountains—especially La Concha—are often capped with snow. You'll cruise past the Golden Mile, the dunes of Cabopino, and perhaps down to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. The marina at Puerto Banús is decorated for Christmas, and many restaurants along the waterfront offer festive menus. While swimming is possible, most guests prefer to enjoy the views, sip cava, and soak up the winter sun from the deck. Remember to bring a jacket—temperatures drop quickly after sunset.

Festive Season Charter Options

December charters can be tailored for festive celebrations. Whether it's a Christmas lunch with colleagues, a New Year's Eve cruise, or a quiet family outing, we can arrange catering upgrades. Our standard inclusions cover drinks and snacks, but we can coordinate with local caterers for a full festive menu. The Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) are particularly suited for special occasions, with ample interior saloons and flybridge space. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your requirements—pricing for these larger yachts is on request.

Where to Cruise in December

Popular December routes include a coastal cruise from Puerto Banús to Marbella's old town, or east towards Cabopino and Calahonda. The sea conditions are usually calm enough to venture towards Estepona or even Sotogrande on a longer charter. The benefit of December is the lack of summer traffic—you'll have the anchorages and coves almost to yourself. We recommend a 4-hour charter (departing around 13:00) to catch the warmest part of the day, or a 6-hour charter (12:00–18:00) to include the sunset. For more inspiration, see our blog on Marbella boat rental tips.

Packing Tips for December Boat Rentals

Layering is key. Start with a long-sleeve shirt, add a fleece or sweater, and top with a windproof jacket. Jeans or comfortable trousers are fine; avoid shorts unless you're used to cooler weather. Sunglasses and sunscreen are still necessary—the sun reflects off the water and can be strong even in winter. Non-slip shoes are recommended for safety on deck. If you plan to swim, bring a wetsuit (or we can advise where to hire one). The boat's interior is heated, so you can always warm up between deck sessions.

Book Your December Charter Today

December availability is generally good, but popular boats like the Astondoa 40 and Mangusta 80 book quickly for festive dates. Contact us via WhatsApp or email to check availability and secure your preferred slot. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. For more details on our full fleet and pricing, visit our Marbella boat rental page.
